code-quality.notes: Functions under 50 lines, type hints throughout, clear dataclasses. Minor: _fetch_from_api inline import time.

architecture.notes: Clean eval-only separation; GroundTruthGraph reads zip in-memory; JiraClient disk cache decoupled from graph. No layer violations.

summary: All 16 acceptance criteria and 4 edge cases pass. GroundTruthGraph loads 58,124 bug commits from replication zip without disk extraction. Coverage CLI reports 100% fix and issue chain completeness on train split (22,421 buggy commits). JiraClient cache read/write and HTTP error handling verified with mocks (no live JIRA calls).
recommendations: Zip contains 14 projects with commit_links files (MESOS has issue CSV but no commit_links); document if 15-project expectation persists in architecture docs.
Consider unit tests in tests/ for regression coverage of graph edge cases and JiraClient retry logic.
